description: Generic OData query against any OpenFEMA dataset. Specify the entity name (and optionally version; defaults to the verified current version) plus OData params: filter, select, orderby, top, skip. Use list_datasets to see available entities/versions and the filter syntax. Returns { metadata, records }.

filter.description: OData $filter, e.g. "state eq 'TX' and fyDeclared eq 2023".

version.description: Path version like 'v1'/'v2'/'v4'. Optional — defaults to the verified current version for known entities.

name: query_dataset
title: Query Dataset
